subject.title: Huntington Beach City School District Board, Trustee Area 4

text: It has been an honor to serve on the Huntington Beach City School Board for the past eight years. As a 51-year resident of Huntington Beach I have dedicated my life to HBCSD, as a teacher for 39 years, and a proud parent of three children who have attended HB City Schools. I believe in my core that the needs of students must be prioritized above any other agenda. As a teacher, I served as a teacher of the year, PTA liaison, coach, and athletic director. I also served as part of the team that earned the California Distinguished School and National Blue-Ribbon School awards.

As a member of the board, I have worked productively with our governance team. We have worked to improve communication with all stakeholders, transparency and accountability in budget decisions, finishing our modernization project and building a new Sowers. Since we are now community funded, we have been able to lower class sizes and offer competitive salaries in order to keep the best teachers and staff. We have instituted science-based teaching strategies and have seen an increase in our students' achievement. Some of the awards our schools have received in the past four years include; California Distinguished Schools, California School to Watch, Gold PBIS Recognition, and Scholar Designation Performance.

In the next four years we will have facilities projects to finish such as bus storage along with maintenance and operations. We will be starting our next five-year strategic plan cycle that will set the goals that will further the advancement of our students. I ask for your continued support in order to finish these projects and to provide the best learning environment for our students. I appreciate your faith and support in the past and hope you will vote for me again.

text: As an Edison High School graduate, mother of two children who attended Huntington Beach City School District schools for 13 years, and longtime community advocate, I have dedicated my life to serving Huntington Beach students and families.

Our district is finally in a strong financial position under Basic Aid. We should protect that success by managing taxpayer dollars responsibly, maintaining transparency, preserving neighborhood schools, and safeguarding community assets for future generations. I believe there is no reason to sell district land or close neighborhood schools when sound financial stewardship can protect both.

My commitment is proven through years of service. I served ten years on a PTA Executive Board, including as PTA President, have attended every School Board meeting for the past eight years, and maintain a community information page that keeps parents informed and engaged on important district issues and Board actions because accountable leadership matters.

I received the Mayor's Spotlight Award for co-leading Peterson Elementary's annual Read Across America celebration, bringing more than 50 community leaders into classrooms each year to promote literacy and inspire young readers. As a former Huntington Beach Community & Library Services Commissioner, I advocated for transparency, public engagement, and responsible stewardship of our community resources.

Professionally, I serve as a Technical Education Advisor at an Orange County career-connected training center, helping students develop career skills, earn industry certifications, and prepare for successful careers. I have secured grant funding that has opened doors for at-risk youth and students with disabilities to receive vocational training, industry-recognized certifications, and life-changing opportunities.

Whether advocating for families, supporting students through difficult circumstances, or creating opportunities that change lives, I have always believed every child deserves someone willing to stand beside them.

I believe our strongest schools are built through transparency, community partnerships, and opportunities for every student to succeed. As your Trustee, I will continue bringing people together to protect our neighborhood schools, support academic excellence and career pathways, and ensure every child has the opportunity to thrive.
I would be honored to earn your vote for Huntington Beach City School District Trustee, Area 4.
